selection_stage: secondary (log-loss tie within epsilon, resolved by highest mean CV ROC-AUC)
selection_rule: 1) PRIMARY: lowest mean CV log loss. 2) EQUIVALENCE: candidates within 0.002 of the best mean log loss are treated as essentially equivalent. 3) SECONDARY: highest mean CV ROC-AUC. 4) TERTIARY: lower CV log-loss standard deviation. 5) COMPLEXITY (deterministic, in order): lower max_depth -> higher min_child_weight -> higher gamma -> higher reg_lambda -> higher reg_alpha -> lower median effective tree count -> candidate_id lexicographic order. subsample/colsample_bytree are tunable predictive hyperparameters and are deliberately NOT used as a model-complexity ranking.
early_stopping_api: xgboost 3.4.0: early_stopping_rounds passed as an XGBClassifier constructor keyword + fit(eval_set=[(inner_early_stop)])
